personality_one_liner: A highly legible, professional field-service tool that instills trust and operational clarity on the job site.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing and fat-finger accessibility (minimum 44x44pt tap targets) for field technicians. Ensure comfortable vertical rhythm inside form flows.

do's: Sticky footer container for Next/Submit buttons in the form wizards

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Login flow prioritizing Google SSO and Email/Password.

states.error: Inline text below the input or a toast.

screens.layout: Vertical stack centered in the lower half of the screen. Splash hero image on top half.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Overview of recent documents (DiCo/DiRi) and quick actions to create new ones.

states.empty: Illustration of a blueprint/clipboard with a prompt to 'Create your first document'.
states.error: Failed to load documents error state with Retry button.

screens.layout: Large pinned header with 'Quick Create' primary actions. Below: a grouped list (surfaceSecondary cards) of Recent Documents with glanceable status badges.

screens.name: Wizard_DiCo
screens.purpose: Multi-step form for generating a Declaration of Conformity.

states.error: Inline validation errors next to specific fields.

screens.layout: Single-column layout with 2-5 fields per step. Thin horizontal progress bar at the top ('Step 2 of 5'). Sticky footer container at the bottom with a primary 'Next' button (anchored above the safe area, using glass blur). Use native pickers and large tap targets.

screens.name: Registries (Clients/Installations)
screens.purpose: Manage saved client data and installation sites to reuse in future documents.

states.empty: Empty state illustration with CTA to 'Add Client'.

screens.layout: Search bar at the top. Flat list of cards displaying client/site info. FAB (Floating Action Button) or prominent Top Header button to add new.

splash_hero.alt: HVAC plumbing tools flat lay for background

instructions_to_main_agent: Adopt 'iOS-Native Clean' personality. Keep the app highly legible and functional for field workers. Maintain a professional, clean UI.
Use the Terracotta (#C54B3C) as the primary brand color representing heat/plumbing. Avoid ALL blues/purples.
For the Multi-step Wizard (DiCo/DiRi), implement a thin horizontal progress bar at the top.

Place the primary CTA (Next / Submit) in a sticky footer container at the bottom of the screen (anchored above the safe area) during the form wizard flows. Use expo-blur for this container's background so scrolling content is visible beneath it.
Ensure all tap targets (buttons, list rows, form fields) are at least 44x44pt (preferably 48pt) to accommodate fat-finger accessibility on job sites.
Implement inline validation and use native input types (e.g., numeric, email) to trigger the correct keyboards.
Ensure list rows use brandTertiary tinted rounded squares for feature icons to add visual depth.
Include haptic feedback on tab changes, primary button presses, and wizard step completions.
